note: Order follows the official guide: the address and siblings are entered while adding the student, before choosing programs.

steps.quote: Part I.3-4: If you already have a parent portal account, you may log in with your account email and password. If you do not have an account, you may create a new parent account by clicking on “Register.”
Part II.1-2: On the Dashboard screen, click “Add/Edit Student.” ... To add a new student, click on “New student.”
Part II.4: begin typing your home address and then select the verified address from the list You will see the green “verified” address message.
Part II.6: On the final screen, you will select siblings. Select all siblings and click “Next: Confirm and Apply.”
Part III.1, 6: From the Dashboard, click on “Apply to Programs.” ... Click on each of the programs you would like to apply for and click “Next.”
Part III.6a: If you apply for a Magnet program, you can make a maximum of three choices.

Part III.6b, 6h: If you apply for a Multilingual Multicultural program, you can make a maximum of three choices ... you will need to select the Languages(s) spoken at home and the language(s) your child speaks.
Part III.8-9: Click on “I agree…” and click “Submit.” ... You may print your confirmation now ... You will also receive a confirmation email.
